name: Osama Halabi
title: Associate Professor
department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering
positioning_line: Researching Virtual Reality, Haptics, and Human-Centered Computing at Qatar University.
professional_summary: Academic and researcher with over 20 years of experience in Virtual Reality (VR), Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Haptics, and Multimodal Interfaces. Currently an Associate Professor at Qatar University, with over 140 peer-reviewed publications, edited volumes, and a patent spanning extended reality (XR), telexistence systems, and human-centered interactive applications. Recognized among the Top 2% Scientists Worldwide for 2025 by Stanford University and Elsevier.
lab_description: XReality Lab works across haptics, virtual and augmented reality, interactive media systems, human-computer interaction, computer graphics, laser projection, and robotics. Work spans Japan Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (2001-2003), the Virtual System Laboratory at Gifu University (2003-2006), and Iwate University, with a current focus on VR, gaming, and interactive media at Qatar University -- building systems that combine haptic feedback, immersive environments, and multimodal interaction for training, accessibility, healthcare, and creative applications.
